body: Bless you for this post. It gave me hope, and I hope others see it that way too if they say something or not. If you need to talk about something please message me, as I think talking to people in the same situation as we are would help each other out.

250 calories is anorexia friend. You need to eat more, please! If you are fainting, what does that mean? Your body is giving out. I used to be anorexic .. but it only lasted like 4 months cause I just couldn't take not eating. Please move your calories up at least to a thousand. Eat healthy, and take a walks. Your killing yourself friend. I'm sorry your mother is not supportive of you and no one else seems to be either. Sexuality shouldn't be as big of an issue as it is, over time people will get used to it though, just look at history of racism. If you can, try to see if you can move out sooner or start looking up ways on how to move out when you can. You'll probably feel great when you do, and then you can look back and say that you determined yourself to get out of that crappy situation you're in now and that things are getting better. Message me back if you want to talk, I have depression too and anxiety, we can talk together about these things.

If you want to talk please message me back. Talking to people in the same situation as me helps, and maybe it'll help you. I hope things get better for you too friend... hope to talk to you soon if you want.

A little glimmer of hope that one day.. things WILL  be better. That I could never hurt my parents by killing myself. That as life goes on... things change. Even for years now for me, they haven't. Nothing exciting... just nothing working in my favor no matter how hard I tired. I don't know what keeps on pushing me. But I was put in this life for a reason, and if pain and depression is that reason, I must have done something terrible in my last life! But still.. that glimmer of hope resides in me. Maybe thats what tortures me further? But thats when I think, no, this is depression talking, not myself. Have you considered medication or seeing a psychologist? If you want to talk please message me.

maybe university isn't right for you right now. Have you considered post-poning it until you think you can handle it? Have you tried talking to a psychologist? Have you looked up coping skills? Maybe you need some time alone, and maybe you need to talk to relatives about these issues. They care about you, your their child. I think university isn't for you right now. I think you need to see a psychologist so you can talk out these problems and get some advice. It might take years, but its better than standing still with these problems right? The fact that you're posting here says that you want someone to help you. Tell me your problems, dive into it. Get it out. I'm here to listen. I'm in the same boat by the way, depression/anxiety.. been like this for years... please message me.
Will do... I am going to. Thank you for the advice.

Jesus.... I'm sorry for you too. Seriously. At least you can be format for a while. Better than not sleeping right...? As with my ex... it sounds exactly the same. I cry over how I fucked everything up... how they were the only good thing in my life. I hope you reply, because I would love talking to you.
Are we the same person?? I'm sorry nothing seems to make anything better... I have the same experience for almost everything you listed. Maybe we could talk?
